description: Substituting primitive-recursive functions into a primitive-recursive relation preserves primitive recursiveness.
signature:
PrimrecPred.comp.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable β] {p : β → Prop} {f : α → β}
  (hp : PrimrecPred p) (hf : Primrec f) : PrimrecPred fun a => p (f a)
